rv-fe:settings-platform:25.note: Open for discussion (owner 2026-11-15). Findings: (1) SVG: applySafeContentHeaders serves any type outside the inline-safe list (png, jpeg, webp, gif, avif, bmp, pdf, audio, video) as application/octet-stream with Content-Disposition attachment and a CSP sandbox, so an SVG profile picture is never drawn and never runs; the upload check (account/profile/actions.ts) only requires an image/* type. Allowing SVG upload therefore has no effect except a picture that does not show; rejecting it at upload is a one-line change. (2) Path rule: /api/files fetches any backend path that does not start with api/ using the signed-in user's token, on the fixed ERP backend host only (no cross-host). HRM-sourced users: the proxy cannot reach an HRM host; images that live on the HRM backend need their own proxy or a direct URL. Not changed.
